details: Grand Theft Auto VI – Open-world action-adventure game by Rockstar Games.
GameDetails: Grand Theft Auto VI is an open-world action adventure from Rockstar Games, set in the lively state of Leonida and its famous Vice City. Follow Jason and Lucia as their story unfolds across urban streets and surrounding locations. Explore, drive, discover activities, and experience a crime-focused story in a detailed modern setting.

details: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare – First-person military shooter.
GameDetails: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare is a first-person military shooter that follows soldiers through a contemporary conflict. Its campaign moves between different viewpoints and missions, combining infantry combat with cinematic set pieces. Players use a range of weapons and equipment while following a tense storyline focused on modern warfare.

details: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice – Action-adventure featuring challenging sword combat.
GameDetails: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice is an action-adventure game set in a fictional version of Sengoku-era Japan. Play as a shinobi known as the Wolf and face difficult opponents using precise swordplay, deflections, stealth, and special tools. Explore connected environments, overcome powerful bosses, and uncover the story of a dangerous rescue mission.

details: Beast of Reincarnation – Action RPG featuring a human and dog partnership.
GameDetails: Beast of Reincarnation is an action role-playing adventure from Game Freak, set in a post-apocalyptic world. The experience centres on a human protagonist and a dog companion, bringing their partnership into exploration and combat. Travel through hostile environments, face dangerous opponents, and discover the mysteries behind this unusual world together.

details: Red Dead Redemption 2 – Open-world western adventure.
GameDetails: Red Dead Redemption 2 is an open-world western adventure from Rockstar Games. Follow outlaw Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang as their way of life changes across a vast frontier. Explore towns, wilderness, and settlements, meet memorable characters, take part in varied activities, and experience a story about loyalty and survival.

details: Marvel's Wolverine – Superhero action-adventure featuring Wolverine.
GameDetails: Marvel's Wolverine is a superhero action adventure featuring the Marvel character Wolverine. The game focuses on his distinctive claws, close-range combat, and a personal story shaped by his past. Explore its environments, confront dangerous enemies, and experience an action-driven interpretation of the character from the developers at Insomniac Games.

label: new
details: Phantom Blade Zero – Action RPG featuring martial arts combat.
GameDetails: Phantom Blade Zero is an action role-playing game with a martial arts-inspired world and fast, stylish sword combat. Players take the role of a warrior caught in a dark story, facing skilled enemies through carefully timed attacks and movement. Its visual direction draws on Chinese cultural influences and dramatic action cinema.

details: God of War Ragnarök – Norse mythology action-adventure.
GameDetails: God of War Ragnarök continues the journey of Kratos and his son Atreus through the realms of Norse mythology. As Fimbulwinter spreads and Ragnarök approaches, they encounter gods, creatures, and difficult choices. The adventure combines exploration, puzzle-solving, character-driven storytelling, and powerful combat with a variety of weapons and abilities.

details: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 – Superhero adventure featuring Peter Parker and Miles Morales.
GameDetails: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 lets players take control of Peter Parker and Miles Morales as they protect New York City. Swing through an expanded city, switch between the two heroes, and use their different abilities in combat and exploration. The story introduces major threats, including Venom and Kraven, in a cinematic superhero adventure.

details: Horizon Forbidden West – Open-world action adventure.
GameDetails: Horizon Forbidden West follows Aloy as she travels beyond familiar lands into a dangerous western frontier. A mysterious plague threatens life, while powerful machines roam varied environments. Explore settlements and wilderness, use a range of weapons and tools, uncover the world's past, and meet new characters during Aloy's search for answers.

details: The Last of Us Part I – Story-driven survival adventure.
GameDetails: The Last of Us Part I is a rebuilt version of the story-driven survival adventure starring Joel and Ellie. Travel across a post-apocalyptic United States where danger comes from both infected creatures and other people. The journey explores trust, loss, and connection through character-focused storytelling, exploration, stealth, and tense encounters.
GameName: THE LAST OF US PART I

details: Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut – Samurai action adventure.
GameDetails: Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut follows samurai Jin Sakai during the Mongol invasion of Tsushima Island. As he tries to protect his home, Jin must reconsider the traditions that shaped him. Explore scenic landscapes, challenge enemies with sword combat or stealth, and experience the main story alongside additional Iki Island content.

details: Elden Ring – Open-world fantasy action RPG.
GameDetails: Elden Ring is an open-world action role-playing game created by FromSoftware, with worldbuilding by George R. R. Martin. Explore the Lands Between, discover hidden places, meet unusual characters, and face formidable enemies. Build a character around different weapons, magic, and skills while uncovering the mysteries of the shattered Elden Ring.

details: Demon's Souls – Dark fantasy action RPG.
GameDetails: Demon's Souls is a dark fantasy role-playing adventure set in the troubled kingdom of Boletaria. A mysterious fog has brought dangerous demons into the land, and a lone warrior must face them. Explore hostile areas, learn enemy patterns, manage resources, and overcome demanding battles in this remake built for PlayStation 5.

details: Returnal – Science-fiction roguelike shooter.
GameDetails: Returnal is a third-person science-fiction roguelike shooter about Selene, an astronaut stranded on a mysterious alien planet. Each cycle brings new challenges as she explores changing environments and confronts hostile creatures. Fast movement, responsive shooting, and repeated attempts are central to the experience, while the unfolding story reveals more about her situation.

details: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart – Action platformer.
GameDetails: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart is a colourful action platformer starring the familiar Lombax hero Ratchet and a new companion, Rivet. Travel between dimensions, explore imaginative worlds, and use an inventive collection of gadgets and weapons. The adventure combines fast combat, platforming, humour, and visual effects that showcase rapid world transitions.

details: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth – Fantasy role-playing adventure.
GameDetails: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth continues the remake trilogy's retelling of the classic role-playing story. Cloud and his companions leave Midgar and travel across a much larger world, meeting allies and confronting new dangers. Explore open regions, take part in real-time and command-based battles, and follow the group's developing relationships and goals.

details: Astro Bot – Colourful 3D platformer.
GameDetails: Astro Bot is a cheerful three-dimensional platform adventure starring the small robot Astro. Travel through imaginative stages, overcome playful obstacles, and rescue scattered robot friends. Each level introduces new ideas, abilities, and surprises, while familiar PlayStation references appear throughout. Its accessible controls and creative design make exploration the centre of the experience.

details: Black Myth: Wukong – Mythology-inspired action RPG.
GameDetails: Black Myth: Wukong is an action role-playing game inspired by the Chinese novel Journey to the West. Play as the Destined One and travel through a mythological world filled with unusual creatures and powerful bosses. Use staff-based combat, transformations, and special abilities while discovering stories inspired by Chinese folklore.

details: Cyberpunk 2077 – Futuristic open-world RPG.
GameDetails: Cyberpunk 2077 is a first-person open-world role-playing game set in the futuristic city of Night City. Play as V, a mercenary searching for a way to survive after obtaining a mysterious implant. Explore districts, meet characters, complete missions, customise equipment and abilities, and make choices that shape parts of the story.

details: Resident Evil 4 – Survival horror action adventure.
GameDetails: Resident Evil 4 is a survival horror remake starring Leon S. Kennedy, who is sent to rescue the president's daughter from a remote European village. Explore unsettling locations, manage limited supplies, solve environmental puzzles, and face dangerous enemies. Its mix of tense exploration and action creates a modern take on the original adventure.

details: Hogwarts Legacy – Open-world wizarding adventure.
GameDetails: Hogwarts Legacy is an open-world action role-playing game set in the wizarding world during the 1800s. Create a student and attend Hogwarts, where you learn spells, explore familiar locations, and uncover an ancient mystery. Visit surrounding areas, discover magical creatures, complete quests, and develop your character through choices and abilities.

details: Baldur's Gate 3 – Choice-driven fantasy RPG.
GameDetails: Baldur's Gate 3 is a choice-driven role-playing game based on the world and rules of Dungeons & Dragons. Build a character, gather companions, and travel through a fantasy setting shaped by your decisions. Battles use turn-based tactics, while dialogue and quest choices can lead to different outcomes and relationships.

details: Death Stranding Director's Cut – Exploration adventure.
GameDetails: Death Stranding Director's Cut follows Sam Porter Bridges on a journey across a fractured America. Travel through challenging landscapes, deliver important cargo, and help reconnect isolated communities through a communication network. The experience blends exploration, planning, unusual encounters, and a mysterious story, with additional content and features included in this edition.

details: Stellar Blade – Science-fiction action adventure.
GameDetails: Stellar Blade is a science-fiction action adventure in which Eve arrives on a devastated Earth to confront the Naytiba. Explore ruined locations, uncover information about the world's condition, and fight enemies using responsive blade combat. Timing, dodging, and parrying are important, while the story gradually reveals the mission's larger purpose.

details: Silent Hill 2 – Psychological horror adventure.
GameDetails: Silent Hill 2 is a psychological horror remake following James Sunderland as he visits the fog-covered town of Silent Hill. He has received a letter connected to his late wife, drawing him into a disturbing search. Explore abandoned locations, solve puzzles, and face frightening encounters as the story examines grief and memory.

details: Assassin's Creed Shadows – Feudal Japan action adventure.
GameDetails: Assassin's Creed Shadows is an action adventure set in feudal Japan. Play as two protagonists, the shinobi Naoe and the samurai Yasuke, each offering a different approach to missions. Explore a changing open world, use stealth or direct combat, gather information, and experience a story shaped by the period's conflicts.

details: Ghost of Yōtei – Action-adventure set in 1600s Ezo.
GameDetails: Ghost of Yōtei is an action adventure from Sucker Punch Productions, set in the region of Ezo during the 1600s. Follow Atsu, a wandering mercenary pursuing the outlaws who wronged her. Travel through striking landscapes, encounter people across the region, and take on a personal journey built around exploration and combat.

label: new
details: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach – Cinematic exploration adventure.
GameDetails: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach continues Sam Porter Bridges' unusual journey in a world struggling to reconnect. Developed by Kojima Productions, the adventure combines travel, deliveries, exploration, and cinematic storytelling. Sam encounters new people and challenges as the story asks questions about connection, responsibility, and whether humanity should remain linked.

label: new
details: Resident Evil Requiem – Survival horror adventure.
GameDetails: Resident Evil Requiem is a survival horror entry from Capcom. It continues the series' focus on dangerous locations, tense exploration, limited resources, and threatening enemies. Players can expect a story-led horror experience built around investigation and survival, with its mysteries and characters forming the centre of the adventure.

label: new
details: Saros – Third-person science-fiction shooter.
GameDetails: Saros is a science-fiction action shooter from Housemarque, set around a mysterious alien world. Its combat focuses on quick movement, precise shooting, and surviving intense enemy attacks. Explore the unfamiliar environment, face escalating challenges, and uncover the secrets behind the setting through an action experience built around skill and persistence.

label: new
details: Crimson Desert – Open-world fantasy action adventure.
GameDetails: Crimson Desert is an open-world action adventure from Pearl Abyss, set across a large fantasy continent. Its world features exploration, dramatic encounters, and large-scale battles. Players follow a story through varied locations while taking part in cinematic combat and discovering the people, conflicts, and challenges that shape the continent.

label: new
details: 007 First Light – Spy action adventure.
GameDetails: 007 First Light is a spy action adventure from IO Interactive that explores the origins of a young James Bond. The experience combines stealth, gadgets, action, and espionage missions. Follow Bond as he develops into an agent, navigates dangerous situations, and faces challenges in a story inspired by the world of spy thrillers.

label: new
details: Battlefield 6 – First-person military shooter.
GameDetails: Battlefield 6 is a first-person military shooter focused on large-scale modern warfare. Its battles bring together infantry, vehicles, and destructible environments, creating changing combat situations. Players can work with teammates, use different roles and equipment, and take part in multiplayer conflicts where coordination and adapting to the battlefield matter.

label: new
details: DOOM: The Dark Ages – First-person shooter.
GameDetails: DOOM: The Dark Ages is a first-person shooter from id Software, presenting a medieval-inspired chapter in the DOOM universe. The game centres on aggressive combat against demonic enemies, with heavy weapons and a shield adding different ways to fight. Its dark fantasy setting gives the series' action a distinctive visual style.

label: new
details: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 – Turn-based fantasy RPG.
GameDetails: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a turn-based role-playing game from Sandfall Interactive, set in a Belle Époque-inspired fantasy world. A group known as Expedition 33 undertakes a dangerous mission against a mysterious force. Its battles combine strategic turn-based choices with timed actions, while the story follows the expedition and its members.

label: new
details: Monster Hunter Wilds – Action RPG featuring giant monster hunts.
GameDetails: Monster Hunter Wilds is an action role-playing game from Capcom where hunters track and battle enormous monsters. Explore dynamic environments that change with their conditions, prepare equipment, and learn the behaviour of each creature. Hunt alone or with other players, gather materials, and craft stronger gear to take on tougher challenges.
